Presidential Documents
55243 
Federal Register 
Vol. 83, No. 213 
Friday, November 2, 2018 
Title 3— 
The President 
Executive Order 13850 of November 1, 2018 
Blocking Property of Additional Persons Contributing to the 
Situation in Venezuela 
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the 
laws of the United States of America, including the International Emergency 
Economic Powers Act (50 U.S.C. 1701 et seq.) (IEEPA), the National Emer-
gencies Act (50 U.S.C. 1601 et seq.), section 212(f) of the Immigration and 
Nationality Act of 1952 (8 U.S.C. 1182(f)) (INA), the Venezuela Defense 
of Human Rights and Civil Society Act of 2014 (Public Law 113–278), 
as amended (the Venezuelan Defense of Human Rights Act), and section 
301 of title 3, United States Code, 
I, DONALD J. TRUMP, President of the United States of America, in order 
to take additional steps with respect to the national emergency declared 
in Executive Order 13692 of March 8, 2015, and relied upon for additional 
steps taken in Executive Order 13808 of August 24, 2017, Executive Order 
13827 of March 19, 2018, and Executive Order 13835 of May 21, 2018, 
particularly in light of actions by the Maduro regime and associated persons 
to plunder Venezuela’s wealth for their own corrupt purposes, degrade Ven-
ezuela’s infrastructure and natural environment through economic mis-
management and confiscatory mining and industrial practices, and catalyze 
a regional migration crisis by neglecting the basic needs of the Venezuelan 
people, hereby order as follows: 
Section 1. (a) All property and interests in property that are in the United 
States, that hereafter come within the United States, or that are or hereafter 
come within the possession or control of any United States person of the 
following persons are blocked and may not be transferred, paid, exported, 
withdrawn, or otherwise dealt in: any person determined by the Secretary 
of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary of State: 
(i) to operate in the gold sector of the Venezuelan economy or in any 
other sector of the Venezuelan economy as may be determined by the 
Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary of State; 
(ii) to be responsible for or complicit in, or to have directly or indirectly 
engaged in, any transaction or series of transactions involving deceptive 
practices or corruption and the Government of Venezuela or projects or 
programs administered by the Government of Venezuela, or to be an 
immediate adult family member of such a person; 
(iii) to have materially assisted, sponsored, or provided financial, material, 
or technological support for, or goods or services to or in support of, 
any activity or transaction described in subsection (a)(ii) of this section, 
or any person whose property and interests in property are blocked pursu-
ant to this order; or 
(iv) to be owned or controlled by, or to have acted or purported to 
act for or on behalf of, directly or indirectly, any person whose property 
and interests in property are blocked pursuant to this order. 
(b) The prohibitions in subsection (a) of this section apply except to 
the extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or 
licenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding 
any contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the 
date of this order. 
VerDate Sep<11>2014 18:13 Nov 01, 2018 Jkt 247001 PO 00000 Frm 00003 Fmt 4705 Sfmt 4790 E:\FR\FM\02NOE0.SGM 02NOE0
=== PDF page 2 of 3 ===
55244 Federal Register / Vol. 83, No. 213 / Friday, November 2, 2018 / Presidential Documents 
Sec. 2. The unrestricted immigrant and nonimmigrant entry into the United 
States of aliens determined to meet one or more of the criteria in subsection 
1(a) of this order would be detrimental to the interests of the United States, 
and the entry of such persons into the United States, as immigrants or 
nonimmigrants, is therefore hereby suspended. Such persons shall be treated 
as persons covered by section 1 of Proclamation 8693 of July 24, 2011 
(Suspension of Entry of Aliens Subject to United Nations Security Council 
Travel Bans and International Emergency Economic Powers Act Sanctions). 
Sec. 3. I hereby determine that the making of donations of the type of 
articles specified in section 203(b)(2) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)(2)) by, 
to, or for the benefit of any person whose property and interests in property 
are blocked pursuant to section 1 of this order would seriously impair 
my ability to deal with the national emergency declared in Executive Order 
13692, and I hereby prohibit such donations as provided by section 1 of 
this order. 
Sec. 4. The prohibitions in section 1 of this order include: 
(a) the making of any contribution or provision of funds, goods, or services 
by, to, or for the benefit of any person whose property and interests in 
property are blocked pursuant to this order; and 
(b) the receipt of any contribution or provision of funds, goods, or services 
from any such person. 
Sec. 5. (a) Any transaction that evades or avoids, has the purpose of evading 
or avoiding, causes a violation of, or attempts to violate any of the prohibi-
tions set forth in this order is prohibited. 
(b) Any conspiracy formed to violate any of the prohibitions set forth 
in this order is prohibited. 
Sec. 6. For the purposes of this order: 
(a) the term ‘‘person’’ means an individual or entity; 
(b) the term ‘‘entity’’ means a partnership, association, trust, joint venture, 
corporation, group, subgroup, or other organization; 
(c) the term ‘‘United States person’’ means any United States citizen, 
lawful permanent resident, entity organized under the laws of the United 
States or any jurisdiction within the United States (including foreign 
branches), or any person in the United States; 
(d) the term ‘‘Government of Venezuela’’ means the Government of Ven-
ezuela, any political subdivision, agency, or instrumentality thereof, includ-
ing the Central Bank of Venezuela, and any person owned or controlled 
by, or acting for or on behalf of, the Government of Venezuela. 
Sec. 7. For those persons whose property and interests in property are 
blocked pursuant to this order who might have a constitutional presence 
in the United States, I find that because of the ability to transfer funds 
or other assets instantaneously, prior notice to such persons or to the Govern-
ment of Venezuela of measures to be taken pursuant to this order would 
render those measures ineffectual. I therefore determine that for these meas-
ures to be effective in addressing the national emergency declared in Execu-
tive Order 13692, there need be no prior notice of a listing or determination 
made pursuant to section 1 of this order. 
Sec. 8. The Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary 
of State, is hereby authorized to take such actions, including promulgating 
rules and regulations, and to employ all powers granted to the President 
by IEEPA as may be necessary to implement this order. The Secretary 
of the Treasury may, consistent with applicable law, redelegate any of these 
functions within the Department of the Treasury. All agencies of the United 
States Government shall take all appropriate measures within their authority 
to carry out the provisions of this order. 
Sec. 9. The Secretary of State is hereby authorized to take such actions, 
including the promulgation of rules and regulations, and to employ all 
powers granted to the President by IEEPA, the INA, and section 5 of the

Venezuela Defense of Human Rights Act, including the authorities set forth 
in sections 5(b)(1)(B), 5(c), and 5(d) of that Act, as may be necessary to 
carry out section 2 of this order and the relevant provisions of section 
5 of that Act. The Secretary of State may, consistent with applicable law,

Sec. 10. (a) Nothing in this order shall be construed to impair or otherwise 
affect: 
(i) the authority granted by law to an executive department or agency, 
or the head thereof; or 
(ii) the functions of the Director of the Office of Management and Budget 
relating to budgetary, administrative, or legislative proposals. 
(b) This order shall be implemented consistent with applicable law and 
subject to the availability of appropriations. 
(c) This order is not intended to, and does not, create any right or benefit, 
substantive or procedural, enforceable at law or in equity by any party 
against the United States, its departments, agencies, or entities, its officers, 
employees, or agents, or any other person.

THE PRESIDENT 13359
[3195-01]
Executive Order 12047 •  M arch 27, 1978
Imported Objects of Cultural Significance
By virtue of the authority vested in me by the Act of October 19, 1965,  
entitled “An Act to render immune from seizure under judicial process certain  
objects of cultural significance imported into the United States for temporary  
display or exhibition, and for other purposes” (79 Stat. 985, 22 U.S.C. 2459),  
and as President of the United States of America, it is hereby ordered as  
follows:
Section 1. The Director of the International Communication Agency is  
designated and empowered to perform the functions conferred upon the  
President by the above-mentioned Act and shall be deemed to be authorized,  
without the approval, ratification, or other action of the President, (1) to  
determine that any work of art or other object to be imported into the United  
States within the meaning of the Act is of cultural significance, (2) to deter­
mine that the temporary exhibition or display of any such work of art or other  
object in the United States is in the national interest, and (3) to cause public  
notices of the determinations referred to above to be published in the Feder­
al R egister.
Sec. 2. The Director of the International Communication Agency, in  
carrying out this Order, shall consult with the Secretary of State with respect  
to the determination of national interest, and may consult with the Secretary  
of the Smithsonian Institution, the Director of the National Gallery of Art, and  
with such other officers and agencies of the Government as may be appropri­
ate, with respect to the determination of cultural significance.
Sec. 3. The Director of the International Communication Agency is au­
thorized to delegate within the Agency the functions conferred upon him by  
this Order.
Sec. 4. Executive Order No. 11312 of October 14, 1966 is revoked.
Sec. 5. Any order, regulation, determination or other action which was in  
effect pursuant to the provisions of Executive Order No. 11312 shall remain in  
effect until changed pursuant to the authority provided in this Order.
Sec. 6. This Order shall be effective on April 1, 1978.

Title 3— 
The President 
Executive Order 13882 of July 26, 2019 
Blocking Property and Suspending Entry of Certain Persons 
Contributing to the Situation in Mali 
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the 
laws of the United States of America, including the International Emergency 
Economic Powers Act (50 U.S.C. 1701 et seq.) (IEEPA), the National Emer-
gencies Act (50 U.S.C. 1601 et seq.) (NEA), the United Nations Participation 
Act of 1945 (22 U.S.C. 287c) (UNPA), section 212(f) of the Immigration 
and Nationality Act of 1952 (8 U.S.C. 1182(f)), and section 301 of title 
3, United States Code, and in view of United Nations Security Council 
Resolution (UNSCR) 2374 of September 5, 2017, and UNSCR 2432 of August 
30, 2018. 
I, DONALD J. TRUMP, President of the United States of America, find 
that the situation in Mali, including repeated violations of ceasefire arrange-
ments made pursuant to the 2015 Agreement on Peace and Reconciliation 
in Mali; the expansion of terrorist activities into southern and central Mali; 
the intensification of drug trafficking and trafficking in persons, human 
rights abuses, and hostage-taking; and the intensification of attacks against 
civilians, the Malian defense and security forces, the United Nations Multi-
dimensional Integrated Stabilizations Mission in Mali (MINUSMA), and inter-
national security presences, constitutes an unusual and extraordinary threat 
to the national security and foreign policy of the United States, and I 
hereby declare a national emergency to deal with that threat. I hereby 
order: 
Section 1. (a) All property and interests in property that are in the United 
States, that hereafter come within the United States, or that are or hereafter 
come within the possession or control of any United States person of the 
following persons are blocked and may not be transferred, paid, exported, 
withdrawn, or otherwise dealt in: any person determined by the Secretary 
of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary of State: 
(i) to be responsible for or complicit in, or to have directly or indirectly 
engaged in, any of the following in or in relation to Mali: 
(A) actions or policies that threaten the peace, security, or stability 
of Mali; 
(B) actions or policies that undermine democratic processes or institu-
tions in Mali; 
(C) a hostile act in violation of, or an act that obstructs, including 
by prolonged delay, or threatens the implementation of, the 2015 Agree-
ment on Peace and Reconciliation in Mali; 
(D) planning, directing, sponsoring, or conducting attacks against local, 
regional, or state institutions, the Malian defense and security forces, 
any international security presences, MINUSMA peacekeepers, other 
United Nations or associated personnel, or any other peacekeeping oper-
ations; 
(E) obstructing the delivery or distribution of, or access to, humanitarian 
assistance; 
(F) planning, directing, or committing an act that violates international 
humanitarian law or that constitutes a serious human rights abuse or 
violation, including an act involving the targeting of civilians through

37056 Federal Register / Vol. 84, No. 146 / Tuesday, July 30, 2019 / Presidential Documents

forced displacement, or an attack on a school, hospital, religious site,

(G) the use or recruitment of children by armed groups or armed forces

(H) the illicit production or trafficking of narcotics or their precursors

(I) trafficking in persons, smuggling migrants, or trafficking or smuggling

(J) any transaction or series of transactions involving bribery or other

(ii) to have materially assisted, sponsored, or provided financial, material,

(b) The prohibitions in subsection (a) of this section apply except to

are blocked pursuant to section 1 of this order would seriously impair 
my ability to deal with the national emergency declared in this order, 
and I hereby prohibit such donations as provided by section 1 of this

Sec. 4. The prohibitions in section 1 of this order include but are not 
limited to: 
(a) the making of any contribution or provision of funds, goods, or services 
by, to, or for the benefit of any person whose property and interests in

(b) the receipt of any contribution or provision of funds, goods, or services

(b) Any conspiracy formed to violate any of the prohibitions set forth 
in this order is prohibited.

Iran;\n(d) any transaction or dealing by a United States person, wherever located,\nincluding purchasing, selling, transporting, swapping, brokering, approving,\nfinancing, facilitating, or sale, or\nsupply, directly or indirectly, to Iran or the Government of Iran;\n(e) any approval, financing, facilitation, or guarantee by a United States\nperson, wherever located, of a transaction by a foreign person where the\ntransaction by that foreign person would be prohibited by this order if\nperformed by a United States person or within the United States; and\n(f) any transaction by a United States person or within the United States\nthat evades or avoids, or has the purpose of evading or avoiding, or attempts\nto violate, any of the prohibitions set forth in this order."},{"char_end":6023,"char_start":5790,"text":"Specific licenses issued pursuant to Executive Orders 12613 (of\nOctober 29, 1987), 12957, or 12959 continue in effect in accordance with\ntheir terms except to the extent revoked, amended, or modified by the\nSecretary of the Treasury."},{"char_end":6290,"char_start":6024,"text":"General licenses, regulations, orders, and directives\nissued pursuant to those orders continue in effect in accordance with their\nterms except to the extent inconsistent with this order or to the extent\nrevoked, amended, or modified by the Secretary of the Treasury."},{"char_end":7812,"char_start":6299,"text":"For the purposes of this order:\n(a) the term ‘‘person’’ means an individual or entity;\n(b) the term ‘‘entity’’ means a partnership, association, trust, joint venture,\ncorporation, or other organization;\n(c) the term ‘‘United States person’’ means any United States citizen,\npermanent resident alien, entity organized under the laws of the United\nStates (including foreign branches), or any person in the United States;\n(d) the term ‘‘Iran’’ means the territory of Iran and any other territory\nor marine area, including the exclusive economic zone and continental\nshelf, over which the Government of Iran claims sovereignty, sovereign\nrights, or jurisdiction, provided that the Government of Iran exercises partial\nor total de facto control over the area or derives a benefit from economic\nactivity in the area pursuant to international arrangements;\n(e) the term ‘‘Government of Iran’’ includes the Government of Iran, any\npolitical subdivision, agency, or instrumentality thereof, and any person\nowned or controlled by, or acting for or on behalf of, the Government\nof Iran;\n(f) the term ‘‘new investment’’ means:\n(i) a commitment or contribution of funds or other assets; or\n(ii) a loan or other extension of credit, made after the effective date\nof Executive Order 12957 as to transactions prohibited by that order, or\notherwise made after the effective date of Executive Order 12959.\n=== PDF page 3 of 3 ===\n44533Federal Register / Vol. 62, No. 162 / Thursday, August 21, 1997 / Presidential Documents\nSec. 5."},{"char_end":9698,"char_start":9497,"text":"Executive Order 12613 and subsections\n(a), (b), (c), (d), and (f) of section 1 of Executive Order 12959 are hereby\nrevoked with respect to transactions occurring after the effective date of\nthis order."},{"char_end":10034,"char_start":9699,"text":"The revocation of those provisions shall not alter their applicabil-\nity to any transaction or violation occurring before the effective date of\nthis order, nor shall it affect the applicability of any rule, regulation, order,\nlicense, or other form of administrative action previously taken pursuant\nto Executive Orders 12613 or 12959."},{"char_end":10589,"char_start":10506,"text":"(a) This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on\nAugust 20, 1997."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12959>EO:13059","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted.   Text: [Tef416f21e564f08afdd1f3d7](#tef416f21e564f08afdd1f3d7); absolute characters 10506–10589
- **ACT:EO:12959>EO:13059@04bbef4ba82cfed0**; S409422e9ecce457b6f9ba1d6; {"actor_id":"EO:13059","char_end":8763,"char_start":8562,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"stated_date","effective_date":"1995-05-06","effective_wording":[{"char_end":1383,"char_start":846,"text":"Except to the extent provided in section 3 of this order or in regulations, orders, directives, or licenses issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding any contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the effective date of this order, the importation into the United States of any goods or services of Iranian origin or owned or controlled by the Government of Iran, other than information or informational materials within the meaning of section 203(b)(3) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)(3)), is hereby prohibited."},{"char_end":1732,"char_start":1393,"text":"Except to the extent provided in section 3 of this order, in section 203(b) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)), or in regulations, orders, directives, or licenses issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding any contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the effective date of this order, the following are prohibited:"},{"char_end":3510,"char_start":2958,"text":"(ii) the exportation of such goods, technology, or services to Iran from the United States was subject to export license application requirements under any United States regulations in effect on May 6, 1995, or thereafter is made subject to such requirements imposed independently of the actions taken pursuant to the national emergency declared in Executive Order 12957; provided, however, that this prohibition shall not apply to those goods or that technology subject to export license application requirements if such goods or technology have been:"},{"char_end":5206,"char_start":4973,"text":"Specific licenses issued pursuant to Executive Orders 12613 (of October 29, 1987), 12957, or 12959 continue in effect in accordance with their terms except to the extent revoked, amended, or modified by the Secretary of the Treasury."},{"char_end":5473,"char_start":5207,"text":"General licenses, regulations, orders, and directives issued pursuant to those orders continue in effect in accordance with their terms except to the extent inconsistent with this order or to the extent revoked, amended, or modified by the Secretary of the Treasury."},{"char_end":6867,"char_start":6699,"text":"made after the effective date of Executive Order 12957 as to transactions prohibited by that order, or otherwise made after the effective date of Executive Order 12959."},{"char_end":8763,"char_start":8562,"text":"Executive Order 12613 and subsections (a), (b), (c), (d), and (f) of section 1 of Executive Order 12959 are hereby revoked with respect to transactions occurring after the effective date of this order."},{"char_end":9097,"char_start":8764,"text":"The revocation of those provisions shall not alter their applicability to any transaction or violation occurring before the effective date of this order, nor shall it affect the applicability of any rule, regulation, order, license, or other form of administrative action previously taken pursuant to Executive Orders 12613 or 12959."},{"char_end":9655,"char_start":9572,"text":"(a) This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on August 20, 1997."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12959>EO:13059@04bbef4ba82cfed0","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; {"actor_id":"EO:13059","char_end":9698,"char_start":9497,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":2091,"char_start":1554,"text":"Except to the extent provided in section 3 of this order or\nin regulations, orders, directives, or licenses issued pursuant to this order,\nand notwithstanding any contract entered into or any license or permit\ngranted prior to the effective date of this order, the importation into the\nUnited States of any goods or services of Iranian origin or owned or controlled\nby the Government of Iran, other than information or informational materials\nwithin the meaning of section 203(b)(3) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)(3)),\nis hereby prohibited."},{"char_end":5781,"char_start":2100,"text":"Except to the extent provided in section 3 of this order, in section\n203(b) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)), or in regulations, orders, directives,\nor licenses issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding any contract\nentered into or any license or permit granted prior to the effective date\nof this order, the following are prohibited:\n(a) the exportation, reexportation, sale, or supply, directly or indirectly,\nfrom the United States, or by a United States person, wherever located,\nof any goods, technology, or services to Iran or the Government of Iran,\nincluding the exportation, reexportation, sale, or supply of any goods, tech-\nnology, or services to a person in a third country undertaken with knowledge\nor reason to know that:\n(i) such goods, technology, or services are intended specifically for supply,\ntransshipment, or reexportation, directly or indirectly, to Iran or the Govern-\nment of Iran; or\n(ii) such goods, technology, or services are intended specifically for use\nin the production of, for commingling with, or for incorporation into goods,\ntechnology, or services to be directly or indirectly supplied, transshipped,\nor reexported exclusively or predominantly to Iran or the Government of\nIran;\n(b) the reexportation from a third country, directly or indirectly, by a\nperson other than a United States person of any goods, technology, or\nservices that have been exported from the United States, if:\n(i) undertaken with knowledge or reason to know that the reexportation\nis intended specifically for Iran or the Government of Iran, and\n(ii) the exportation of such goods, technology, or services to Iran from\nthe United States was subject to export license application requirements\nunder any United States regulations in effect on May 6, 1995, or thereafter\n=== PDF page 2 of 3 ===\n44532 Federal Register / Vol. 62, No. 162 / Thursday, August 21, 1997 / Presidential Documents\nis made subject to such requirements imposed independently of the actions\ntaken pursuant to the national emergency declared in Executive Order 12957;\nprovided, however, that this prohibition shall not apply to those goods\nor that technology subject to export license application requirements if such\ngoods or technology have been:\n(A) substantially transformed into a foreign-made product outside the Unit-\ned States; or\n(B) incorporated into a foreign-made product outside the United States\nif the aggregate value of such controlled United States goods and technology\nconstitutes less than 10 percent of the total value of the foreign-made product\nto be exported from a third country;\n(c) any new investment by a United States person in Iran or in property,\nincluding entities, owned or controlled by the Government of Iran;\n(d) any transaction or dealing by a United States person, wherever located,\nincluding purchasing, selling, transporting, swapping, brokering, approving,\nfinancing, facilitating, or guaranteeing, in or related to:\n(i) goods or services of Iranian origin or owned or controlled by the\nGovernment of Iran; or\n(ii) goods, technology, or services for exportation, reexportation, sale, or\nsupply, directly or indirectly, to Iran or the Government of Iran;\n(e) any approval, financing, facilitation, or guarantee by a United States\nperson, wherever located, of a transaction by a foreign person where the\ntransaction by that foreign person would be prohibited by this order if\nperformed by a United States person or within the United States; and\n(f) any transaction by a United States person or within the United States\nthat evades or avoids, or has the purpose of evading or avoiding, or attempts\nto violate, any of the prohibitions set forth in this order."},{"char_end":6023,"char_start":5790,"text":"Specific licenses issued pursuant to Executive Orders 12613 (of\nOctober 29, 1987), 12957, or 12959 continue in effect in accordance with\ntheir terms except to the extent revoked, amended, or modified by the\nSecretary of the Treasury."},{"char_end":6290,"char_start":6024,"text":"General licenses, regulations, orders, and directives\nissued pursuant to those orders continue in effect in accordance with their\nterms except to the extent inconsistent with this order or to the extent\nrevoked, amended, or modified by the Secretary of the Treasury."},{"char_end":7812,"char_start":6299,"text":"For the purposes of this order:\n(a) the term ‘‘person’’ means an individual or entity;\n(b) the term ‘‘entity’’ means a partnership, association, trust, joint venture,\ncorporation, or other organization;\n(c) the term ‘‘United States person’’ means any United States citizen,\npermanent resident alien, entity organized under the laws of the United\nStates (including foreign branches), or any person in the United States;\n(d) the term ‘‘Iran’’ means the territory of Iran and any other territory\nor marine area, including the exclusive economic zone and continental\nshelf, over which the Government of Iran claims sovereignty, sovereign\nrights, or jurisdiction, provided that the Government of Iran exercises partial\nor total de facto control over the area or derives a benefit from economic\nactivity in the area pursuant to international arrangements;\n(e) the term ‘‘Government of Iran’’ includes the Government of Iran, any\npolitical subdivision, agency, or instrumentality thereof, and any person\nowned or controlled by, or acting for or on behalf of, the Government\nof Iran;\n(f) the term ‘‘new investment’’ means:\n(i) a commitment or contribution of funds or other assets; or\n(ii) a loan or other extension of credit, made after the effective date\nof Executive Order 12957 as to transactions prohibited by that order, or\notherwise made after the effective date of Executive Order 12959.\n=== PDF page 3 of 3 ===\n44533Federal Register / Vol. 62, No. 162 / Thursday, August 21, 1997 / Presidential Documents\nSec. 5."},{"char_end":9698,"char_start":9497,"text":"Executive Order 12613 and subsections\n(a), (b), (c), (d), and (f) of section 1 of Executive Order 12959 are hereby\nrevoked with respect to transactions occurring after the effective date of\nthis order."},{"char_end":10034,"char_start":9699,"text":"The revocation of those provisions shall not alter their applicabil-\nity to any transaction or violation occurring before the effective date of\nthis order, nor shall it affect the applicability of any rule, regulation, order,\nlicense, or other form of administrative action previously taken pursuant\nto Executive Orders 12613 or 12959."},{"char_end":10589,"char_start":10506,"text":"(a) This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on\nAugust 20, 1997."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12959>EO:13059@1fbef27b5e392dd6","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted. than information or informational materials\nwithin the meaning of section 203(b)(3) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)(3)),\nis hereby prohibited."},{"char_end":5053,"char_start":1491,"text":"Except to the extent provided in section 3 of this order, in section\n203(b) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)), or in regulations, orders, directives,\nor licenses issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding any contract\nentered into or any license or permit granted prior to the effective date\nof this order, the following are prohibited:\n(a) the exportation, reexportation, sale, or supply, directly or indirectly,\nfrom the United States, or by a United States person, wherever located,\nof any goods, technology, or services to Iran or the Government of Iran,\nincluding the exportation, reexportation, sale, or supply of any goods, tech-\nnology, or services to a person in a third country undertaken with knowledge\nor reason to know that:\n(i) such goods, technology, or services are intended specifically for supply,\ntransshipment, or reexportation, directly or indirectly, to Iran or the Govern-\nment of Iran; or\n(ii) such goods, technology, or services are intended specifically for use\nin the production of, for commingling with, or for incorporation into goods,\ntechnology, or services to be directly or indirectly supplied, transshipped,\nor reexported exclusively or predominantly to Iran or the Government of\nIran;\n(b) the reexportation from a third country, directly or indirectly, by a\nperson other than a United States person of any goods, technology, or\nservices that have been exported from the United States, if:\n(i) undertaken with knowledge or reason to know that the reexportation\nis intended specifically for Iran or the Government of Iran, and\n(ii) the exportation of such goods, technology, or services to Iran from\nthe United States was subject to export license application requirements\nunder any United States regulations in effect on May 6, 1995, or thereafter\nis made subject to such requirements imposed independently of the actions\ntaken pursuant to the national emergency declared in Executive Order 12957;\nprovided, however, that this prohibition shall not apply to those goods\nor that technology subject to export license application requirements if such\ngoods or technology have been:\n(A) substantially transformed into a foreign-made product outside the Unit-\ned States; or\n(B) incorporated into a foreign-made product outside the United States\nif the aggregate value of such controlled United States goods and technology\nconstitutes less than 10 percent of the total value of the foreign-made product\nto be exported from a third country;\n(c) any new investment by a United States person in Iran or in property,\nincluding entities, owned or controlled by the Government of Iran;\n(d) any transaction or dealing by a United States person, wherever located,\nincluding purchasing, selling, transporting, swapping, brokering, approving,\nfinancing, facilitating, or guaranteeing, in or related to:\n(i) goods or services of Iranian origin or owned or controlled by the\nGovernment of Iran; or\n(ii) goods, technology, or services for exportation, reexportation, sale, or\nsupply, directly or indirectly, to Iran or the Government of Iran;\n(e) any approval, financing, facilitation, or guarantee by a United States\nperson, wherever located, of a transaction by a foreign person where the\ntransaction by that foreign person would be prohibited by this order if\nperformed by a United States person or within the United States; and\n(f) any transaction by a United States person or within the United States\nthat evades or avoids, or has the purpose of evading or avoiding, or attempts\nto violate, any of the prohibitions set forth in this order."},{"char_end":5295,"char_start":5062,"text":"Specific licenses issued pursuant to Executive Orders 12613 (of\nOctober 29, 1987), 12957, or 12959 continue in effect in accordance with\ntheir terms except to the extent revoked, amended, or modified by the\nSecretary of the Treasury."},{"char_end":5562,"char_start":5296,"text":"General licenses, regulations, orders, and directives\nissued pursuant to those orders continue in effect in accordance with their\nterms except to the extent inconsistent with this order or to the extent\nrevoked, amended, or modified by the Secretary of the Treasury."},{"char_end":6958,"char_start":5571,"text":"For the purposes of this order:\n(a) the term ‘‘person’’ means an individual or entity;\n(b) the term ‘‘entity’’ means a partnership, association, trust, joint venture,\ncorporation, or other organization;\n(c) the term ‘‘United States person’’ means any United States citizen,\npermanent resident alien, entity organized under the laws of the United\nStates (including foreign branches), or any person in the United States;\n(d) the term ‘‘Iran’’ means the territory of Iran and any other territory\nor marine area, including the exclusive economic zone and continental\nshelf, over which the Government of Iran claims sovereignty, sovereign\nrights, or jurisdiction, provided that the Government of Iran exercises partial\nor total de facto control over the area or derives a benefit from economic\nactivity in the area pursuant to international arrangements;\n(e) the term ‘‘Government of Iran’’ includes the Government of Iran, any\npolitical subdivision, agency, or instrumentality thereof, and any person\nowned or controlled by, or acting for or on behalf of, the Government\nof Iran;\n(f) the term ‘‘new investment’’ means:\n(i) a commitment or contribution of funds or other assets; or\n(ii) a loan or other extension of credit, made after the effective date\nof Executive Order 12957 as to transactions prohibited by that order, or\notherwise made after the effective date of Executive Order 12959."},{"char_end":8852,"char_start":8651,"text":"Executive Order 12613 and subsections\n(a), (b), (c), (d), and (f) of section 1 of Executive Order 12959 are hereby\nrevoked with respect to transactions occurring after the effective date of\nthis order."},{"char_end":9188,"char_start":8853,"text":"The revocation of those provisions shall not alter their applicabil-\nity to any transaction or violation occurring before the effective date of\nthis order, nor shall it affect the applicability of any rule, regulation, order,\nlicense, or other form of administrative action previously taken pursuant\nto Executive Orders 12613 or 12959."},{"char_end":9743,"char_start":9660,"text":"(a) This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on\nAugust 20, 1997."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12959>EO:13059@8884bb48cbdc6c5a","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.","provision_label":"Sec. 7.","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":["Specific licenses issued pursuant to Executive Orders 12613 (of\nOctober 29, 1987), 12957, or 12959 continue in effect in accordance with\ntheir terms except to the extent revoked, amended, or modified by the\nSecretary of the Treasury.","General licenses, regulations, orders, and directives\nissued pursuant to those orders continue in effect in accordance with their\nterms except to the extent inconsistent with this order or to the extent\nrevoked, amended, or modified by the Secretary of the Treasury."],"scope":"partial","signing_date":"1997-08-19","target_id":"EO:12959","verb":"revoke"}

\n(i) the terms ‘‘knowledge’’ and ‘‘knowingly,’’ with respect to conduct, \na circumstance, or a result, mean that a person has actual knowledge, or \nshould have known, of the conduct, the circumstance, or the result; \n(j) the term ‘‘person’’ means an individual or entity; \n(k) the term ‘‘petroleum’’ (also known as crude oil) means a mixture \nof hydrocarbons that exists in liquid phase in natural underground reservoirs \nand remains liquid at atmospheric pressure after passing through surface \nseparating facilities; \n(l) the term ‘‘petroleum products’’ includes unfinished oils, liquefied petro-\nleum gases, pentanes plus, aviation gasoline, motor gasoline, naphtha-type \njet fuel, kerosene-type jet fuel, kerosene, distillate fuel oil, residual fuel \noil, petrochemical feedstocks, special naphthas, lubricants, waxes, petroleum \ncoke, asphalt, road oil, still gas, and miscellaneous products obtained from \nthe processing of: crude oil (including lease condensate), natural gas, and \nother hydrocarbon compounds."],"scope":"partial","signing_date":"2013-06-03","target_id":"EO:13599","verb":"transfer"}

- **ACT:EO:13599>EO:13645@36e8f7bc19fc9f7b**; S5907db7c403eaa1d90991758; {"actor_id":"EO:13645","char_end":6373,"char_start":5325,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":1773,"char_start":1096,"text":"(a) The Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary \nof State, is hereby authorized to impose on a foreign financial institution \nthe sanctions described in subsection (b) of this section upon determining \nthat the foreign financial institution has, on or after the effective date of \nthis order: \n(i) knowingly conducted or facilitated any significant transaction related \nto the purchase or sale of Iranian rials or a derivative, swap, future, \nforward, or other similar contract whose value is based on the exchange \nrate of the Iranian rial; or \n(ii) maintained significant funds or accounts outside the territory of Iran \ndenominated in the Iranian rial."},{"char_end":2983,"char_start":2660,"text":"(c) The prohibitions in subsection (b) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":5315,"char_start":4992,"text":"(c) The prohibitions in subsection (b) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":6373,"char_start":5325,"text":"(a) The Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary \nof State, is hereby authorized to impose on a foreign financial institution \nthe sanctions described in subsection (b) of this section upon determining \nthat the foreign financial institution has knowingly conducted or facilitated \nany significant financial transaction: \n(i) on behalf of any Iranian person included on the SDN List (other \nthan an Iranian depository institution whose property and interests in \nproperty are blocked solely pursuant to Executive Order 13599) or any \nother person included on the SDN List whose property and interests \nin property are blocked pursuant to subsection 2(a)(i) of this order or \nExecutive Order 13599 (other than an Iranian depository institution whose \nproperty and interests in property are blocked solely pursuant to Executive \nOrder 13599); or \n(ii) on or after the effective date of this order, for the sale, supply, or \ntransfer to Iran of significant goods or services used in connection with \nthe automotive sector of Iran."},{"char_end":9058,"char_start":8735,"text":"(f) The prohibitions in subsection (b) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":10873,"char_start":9436,"text":"The Secretary of State, in consultation with the Secretary of the \nTreasury, the Secretary of Commerce, the Secretary of Homeland Security, \nand the United States Trade Representative, and with the President of the \nExport-Import Bank, the Chairman of the Board of Governors of the Federal \nReserve System, and other agencies and officials as appropriate, is hereby \nauthorized to impose on a person any of the sanctions described in section \n6 or 7 of this order upon determining that the person: \n(a) on or after the effective date of this order, knowingly engaged in \na significant transaction for the sale, supply, or transfer to Iran of significant \ngoods or services used in connection with the automotive sector of Iran; \n(b) is a successor entity to a person determined by the Secretary of State \nin accordance with this section to meet the criteria in subsection (a) of \nthis section; \n(c) owns or controls a person determined by the Secretary of State in \naccordance with this section to meet the criteria in subsection (a) of this \nsection, and had knowledge that the person engaged in the activities referred \nto in that subsection; or \n(d) is owned or controlled by, or under common ownership or control \nwith, a person determined by the Secretary of State in accordance with \nthis section to meet the criteria in subsection (a) of this section, and know-\ningly participated in the activities referred to in that subsection."},{"char_end":13888,"char_start":13560,"text":"(g) The prohibitions in subsections (a)–(f) of this section apply except \nto the extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, \nor licenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":17188,"char_start":16865,"text":"(b) The prohibitions in subsection (a) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":18994,"char_start":18671,"text":"(b) The prohibitions in subsection (a) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":29273,"char_start":29016,"text":"I therefore determine that for these measures to be effective in addressing \nthe national emergency declared in Executive Order 12957, there need be \nno prior notice of an action taken pursuant to subsection 1(b)(ii), 2(b), \n7(a)(iv), or 8(a) of this order."},{"char_end":30310,"char_start":29862,"text":"(c) Subsection (a)(i) of section 2 is amended by replacing ‘‘knowingly, \non or after the effective date of this order, engaged in a significant transaction \nfor the purchase or acquisition of petroleum or petroleum products from \nIran’’ with ‘‘knowingly, on or after the effective date of this order, engaged \nin a significant transaction for the purchase, acquisition, sale, transport, \nor marketing of petroleum or petroleum products from Iran’’."},{"char_end":30744,"char_start":30312,"text":"(d) Subsection (a)(ii) of section 2 is amended by replacing ‘‘knowingly, \non or after the effective date of this order, engaged in a significant transaction \nfor the purchase or acquisition of petrochemical products from Iran’’ with \n‘‘knowingly, on or after the effective date of this order, engaged in a signifi-\ncant transaction for the purchase, acquisition, sale, transport, or marketing \nof petrochemical products from Iran’’."},{"char_end":31963,"char_start":31886,"text":"This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on July \n1, 2013."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:13599>EO:13645@36e8f7bc19fc9f7b","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.","provision_label":"Sec. 3.","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":["It includes but is not limited to depository institutions, \nbanks, savings banks, money service businesses, trust companies, securities \nbrokers and dealers, commodity futures and options brokers and dealers, \nforward contract and foreign exchange merchants, securities and commodities \nexchanges, clearing corporations, investment companies, employee benefit \nplans, dealers in precious metals, stones, or jewels, and holding companies, \naffiliates, or subsidiaries of any of the foregoing.","The term does not include \nthe international financial institutions identified in 22 U.S.C. 262r(c)(2), \nthe International Fund for Agricultural Development, the North American \nDevelopment Bank, or any other international financial institution so notified \nby the Secretary of the Treasury; \n(e) the term ‘‘Government of Iran’’ includes the Government of Iran, any \npolitical subdivision, agency, or instrumentality thereof, including the Central \nVerDate Mar<15>2010 19:51 Jun 04, 2013 Jkt 226001 PO 00000 Frm 00006 Fmt 4790 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\05JNE0.SGM 05JNE0mstockstill on DSK4VPTVN1PROD with PREDOCE0\n=== PDF page 7 of 9 ===\n33951 Federal Register / Vol. 78, No. 108 / Wednesday, June 5, 2013 / Presidential Documents \nBank of Iran, and any person owned or controlled by, or acting for or \non behalf of, the Government of Iran; \n(f) the term ‘‘Iran’’ means the Government of Iran and the territory of \nIran and any other territory or marine area, including the exclusive economic \nzone and continental shelf, over which the Government of Iran claims sov-\nereignty, sovereign rights, or jurisdiction, provided that the Government \nof Iran exercises partial or total de facto control over the area or derives \na benefit from economic activity in the area pursuant to international arrange-\nments; \n(g) the term ‘‘Iranian depository institution’’ means any entity (including \nforeign branches), wherever located, organized under the laws of Iran or \nany jurisdiction within Iran, or owned or controlled by the Government \nof Iran, or in Iran, or owned or controlled by any of the foregoing, that \nis engaged primarily in the business of banking (for example, banks, savings \nbanks, savings associations, credit unions, trust companies, and bank holding \ncompanies); \n(h) the term ‘‘Iranian person,’’ as used in sections 2 and 3 of this order, \nmeans an individual who is a citizen or national of Iran or an entity \norganized under the laws of Iran or otherwise subject to the jurisdiction \nof the Government of Iran; \n(i) the terms ‘‘knowledge’’ and ‘‘knowingly,’’ with respect to conduct, \na circumstance, or a result, mean that a person has actual knowledge, or \nshould have known, of the conduct, the circumstance, or the result; \n(j) the term ‘‘person’’ means an individual or entity; \n(k) the term ‘‘petroleum’’ (also known as crude oil) means a mixture \nof hydrocarbons that exists in liquid phase in natural underground reservoirs \nand remains liquid at atmospheric pressure after passing through surface \nseparating facilities; \n(l) the term ‘‘petroleum products’’ includes unfinished oils, liquefied petro-\nleum gases, pentanes plus, aviation gasoline, motor gasoline, naphtha-type \njet fuel, kerosene-type jet fuel, kerosene, distillate fuel oil, residual fuel \noil, petrochemical feedstocks, special naphthas, lubricants, waxes, petroleum \ncoke, asphalt, road oil, still gas, and miscellaneous products obtained from \nthe processing of: crude oil (including lease condensate), natural gas, and \nother hydrocarbon compounds."],"scope":"partial","signing_date":"2013-06-03","target_id":"EO:13599","verb":"transfer"}

upon determining \nthat the foreign financial institution has, on or after the effective date of \nthis order: \n(i) knowingly conducted or facilitated any significant transaction related \nto the purchase or sale of Iranian rials or a derivative, swap, future, \nforward, or other similar contract whose value is based on the exchange \nrate of the Iranian rial; or \n(ii) maintained significant funds or accounts outside the territory of Iran \ndenominated in the Iranian rial."},{"char_end":3594,"char_start":3271,"text":"(c) The prohibitions in subsection (b) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":5926,"char_start":5603,"text":"(c) The prohibitions in subsection (b) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":6984,"char_start":5936,"text":"(a) The Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary \nof State, is hereby authorized to impose on a foreign financial institution \nthe sanctions described in subsection (b) of this section upon determining \nthat the foreign financial institution has knowingly conducted or facilitated \nany significant financial transaction: \n(i) on behalf of any Iranian person included on the SDN List (other \nthan an Iranian depository institution whose property and interests in \nproperty are blocked solely pursuant to Executive Order 13599) or any \nother person included on the SDN List whose property and interests \nin property are blocked pursuant to subsection 2(a)(i) of this order or \nExecutive Order 13599 (other than an Iranian depository institution whose \nproperty and interests in property are blocked solely pursuant to Executive \nOrder 13599); or \n(ii) on or after the effective date of this order, for the sale, supply, or \ntransfer to Iran of significant goods or services used in connection with \nthe automotive sector of Iran."},{"char_end":9669,"char_start":9346,"text":"(f) The prohibitions in subsection (b) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":11484,"char_start":10047,"text":"The Secretary of State, in consultation with the Secretary of the \nTreasury, the Secretary of Commerce, the Secretary of Homeland Security, \nand the United States Trade Representative, and with the President of the \nExport-Import Bank, the Chairman of the Board of Governors of the Federal \nReserve System, and other agencies and officials as appropriate, is hereby \nauthorized to impose on a person any of the sanctions described in section \n6 or 7 of this order upon determining that the person: \n(a) on or after the effective date of this order, knowingly engaged in \na significant transaction for the sale, supply, or transfer to Iran of significant \ngoods or services used in connection with the automotive sector of Iran; \n(b) is a successor entity to a person determined by the Secretary of State \nin accordance with this section to meet the criteria in subsection (a) of \nthis section; \n(c) owns or controls a person determined by the Secretary of State in \naccordance with this section to meet the criteria in subsection (a) of this \nsection, and had knowledge that the person engaged in the activities referred \nto in that subsection; or \n(d) is owned or controlled by, or under common ownership or control \nwith, a person determined by the Secretary of State in accordance with \nthis section to meet the criteria in subsection (a) of this section, and know-\ningly participated in the activities referred to in that subsection."},{"char_end":14499,"char_start":14171,"text":"(g) The prohibitions in subsections (a)–(f) of this section apply except \nto the extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, \nor licenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":17799,"char_start":17476,"text":"(b) The prohibitions in subsection (a) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":19605,"char_start":19282,"text":"(b) The prohibitions in subsection (a) of this section apply except to \nthe extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or \nlicenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding \nany contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the \neffective date of this order."},{"char_end":29884,"char_start":29627,"text":"I therefore determine that for these measures to be effective in addressing \nthe national emergency declared in Executive Order 12957, there need be \nno prior notice of an action taken pursuant to subsection 1(b)(ii), 2(b), \n7(a)(iv), or 8(a) of this order."},{"char_end":30921,"char_start":30473,"text":"(c) Subsection (a)(i) of section 2 is amended by replacing ‘‘knowingly, \non or after the effective date of this order, engaged in a significant transaction \nfor the purchase or acquisition of petroleum or petroleum products from \nIran’’ with ‘‘knowingly, on or after the effective date of this order, engaged \nin a significant transaction for the purchase, acquisition, sale, transport, \nor marketing of petroleum or petroleum products from Iran’’."},{"char_end":31355,"char_start":30923,"text":"(d) Subsection (a)(ii) of section 2 is amended by replacing ‘‘knowingly, \non or after the effective date of this order, engaged in a significant transaction \nfor the purchase or acquisition of petrochemical products from Iran’’ with \n‘‘knowingly, on or after the effective date of this order, engaged in a signifi-\ncant transaction for the purchase, acquisition, sale, transport, or marketing \nof petrochemical products from Iran’’."},{"char_end":32574,"char_start":32497,"text":"This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on July \n1, 2013."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:13599>EO:13645@88894d3fe956949c","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.","provision_label":"Sec. 3.","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":["It includes but is not limited to depository institutions, \nbanks, savings banks, money service businesses, trust companies, securities \nbrokers and dealers, commodity futures and options brokers and dealers, \nforward contract and foreign exchange merchants, securities and commodities \nexchanges, clearing corporations, investment companies, employee benefit \nplans, dealers in precious metals, stones, or jewels, and holding companies, \naffiliates, or subsidiaries of any of the foregoing.","The term does not include \nthe international financial institutions identified in 22 U.S.C. 262r(c)(2), \nthe International Fund for Agricultural Development, the North American \nDevelopment Bank, or any other international financial institution so notified \nby the Secretary of the Treasury; \n(e) the term ‘‘Government of Iran’’ includes the Government of Iran, any \npolitical subdivision, agency, or instrumentality thereof, including the Central \nVerDate Mar<15>2010 19:51 Jun 04, 2013 Jkt 226001 PO 00000 Frm 00006 Fmt 4790 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\05JNE0.SGM 05JNE0mstockstill on DSK4VPTVN1PROD with PREDOCE0\n=== PDF page 7 of 9 ===\n33951 Federal Register / Vol. 78, No. 108 / Wednesday, June 5, 2013 / Presidential Documents \nBank of Iran, and any person owned or controlled by, or acting for or \non behalf of, the Government of Iran; \n(f) the term ‘‘Iran’’ means the Government of Iran and the territory of \nIran and any other territory or marine area, including the exclusive economic \nzone and continental shelf, over which the Government of Iran claims sov-\nereignty, sovereign rights, or jurisdiction, provided that the Government \nof Iran exercises partial or total de facto control over the area or derives \na benefit from economic activity in the area pursuant to international arrange-\nments; \n(g) the term ‘‘Iranian depository institution’’ means any entity (including \nforeign branches), wherever located, organized under the laws of Iran or \nany jurisdiction within Iran, or owned or controlled by the Government \nof Iran, or in Iran, or owned or controlled by any of the foregoing, that \nis engaged primarily in the business of banking (for example, banks, savings \nbanks, savings associations, credit unions, trust companies, and bank holding \ncompanies); \n(h) the term ‘‘Iranian person,’’ as used in sections 2 and 3 of this order, \nmeans an individual who is a citizen or national of Iran or an entity \norganized under the laws of Iran or otherwise subject to the jurisdiction \nof the Government of Iran; \n(i) the terms ‘‘knowledge’’ and ‘‘knowingly,’’ with respect to conduct, \na circumstance, or a result, mean that a person has actual knowledge, or \nshould have known, of the conduct, the circumstance, or the result; \n(j) the term ‘‘person’’ means an individual or entity; \n(k) the term ‘‘petroleum’’ (also known as crude oil) means a mixture \nof hydrocarbons that exists in liquid phase in natural underground reservoirs \nand remains liquid at atmospheric pressure after passing through surface \nseparating facilities; \n(l) the term ‘‘petroleum products’’ includes unfinished oils, liquefied petro-\nleum gases, pentanes plus, aviation gasoline, motor gasoline, naphtha-type \njet fuel, kerosene-type jet fuel, kerosene, distillate fuel oil, residual fuel \noil, petrochemical feedstocks, special naphthas, lubricants, waxes, petroleum \ncoke, asphalt, road oil, still gas, and miscellaneous products obtained from \nthe processing of: crude oil (including lease condensate), natural gas, and \nother hydrocarbon compounds."],"scope":"partial","signing_date":"2013-06-03","target_id":"EO:13599","verb":"transfer"}

Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.","provision_label":"Sec. 2.","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":["It includes, but is not limited \nto, depository institutions, banks, savings banks, money service businesses, \ntrust companies, securities brokers and dealers, commodity futures and op-\ntions brokers and dealers, forward contract and foreign exchange merchants, \nsecurities and commodities exchanges, clearing corporations, investment \ncompanies, employee benefit plans, dealers in precious metals, stones, or \njewels, and holding companies, affiliates, or subsidiaries of any of the fore-\ngoing.","The term does not include the international financial institutions \nidentified in 22 U.S.C. 262r(c)(2), the International Fund for Agricultural \nDevelopment, the North American Development Bank, or any other inter-\nnational financial institution so notified by the Secretary of the Treasury; \n(e) the term ‘‘Government of Iran’’ includes the Government of Iran, any \npolitical subdivision, agency, or instrumentality thereof, including the Central \nBank of Iran, and any person owned or controlled by, or acting for or \non behalf of, the Government of Iran; \n(f) the term ‘‘Iran’’ means the Government of Iran and the territory of \nIran and any other territory or marine area, including the exclusive economic \nzone and continental shelf, over which the Government of Iran claims sov-\nereignty, sovereign rights, or jurisdiction, provided that the Government \nof Iran exercises partial or total de facto control over the area or derives \na benefit from economic activity in the area pursuant to international arrange-\nments; \n(g) the term ‘‘Iranian depository institution’’ means any entity (including \nforeign branches), wherever located, organized under the laws of Iran or \nany jurisdiction within Iran, or owned or controlled by the Government \nof Iran, or in Iran, or owned or controlled by any of the foregoing, that \nis engaged primarily in the business of banking (for example, banks, savings \nbanks, savings associations, credit unions, trust companies, and bank holding \ncompanies); \n(h) the term ‘‘Iranian person’’ means an individual who is a citizen or \nnational of Iran or an entity organized under the laws of Iran or otherwise \nsubject to the jurisdiction of the Government of Iran; \n(i) the terms ‘‘knowledge’’ and ‘‘knowingly,’’ with respect to conduct, \na circumstance, or a result, mean that a person has actual knowledge, or \nshould have known, of the conduct, the circumstance, or the result; \n(k) the terms ‘‘National Iranian Oil Company’’ and ‘‘NIOC’’ mean the \nNational Iranian Oil Company and any entity owned or controlled by, or \noperating for or on behalf of, the National Iranian Oil Company; ending or revival asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.","provision_label":"Sec. 2.","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":["It includes, but is not limited \nto, depository institutions, banks, savings banks, money service businesses, \ntrust companies, securities brokers and dealers, commodity futures and op-\ntions brokers and dealers, forward contract and foreign exchange merchants, \nsecurities and commodities exchanges, clearing corporations, investment \ncompanies, employee benefit plans, dealers in precious metals, stones, or \njewels, and holding companies, affiliates, or subsidiaries of any of the fore-\ngoing.","The term does not include the international financial institutions \nidentified in 22 U.S.C. 262r(c)(2), the International Fund for Agricultural \nDevelopment, the North American Development Bank, or any other inter-\nnational financial institution so notified by the Secretary of the Treasury; \n(e) the term ‘‘Government of Iran’’ includes the Government of Iran, any \npolitical subdivision, agency, or instrumentality thereof, including the Central \nBank of Iran, and any person owned or controlled by, or acting for or \non behalf of, the Government of Iran; \n(f) the term ‘‘Iran’’ means the Government of Iran and the territory of \nIran and any other territory or marine area, including the exclusive economic \nzone and continental shelf, over which the Government of Iran claims sov-\nereignty, sovereign rights, or jurisdiction, provided that the Government \nof Iran exercises partial or total de facto control over the area or derives \na benefit from economic activity in the area pursuant to international arrange-\nments; \n(g) the term ‘‘Iranian depository institution’’ means any entity (including \nforeign branches), wherever located, organized under the laws of Iran or \nany jurisdiction within Iran, or owned or controlled by the Government \nof Iran, or in Iran, or owned or controlled by any of the foregoing, that \nis engaged primarily in the business of banking (for example, banks, savings \nbanks, savings associations, credit unions, trust companies, and bank holding \ncompanies); \n(h) the term ‘‘Iranian person’’ means an individual who is a citizen or \nnational of Iran or an entity organized under the laws of Iran or otherwise \nsubject to the jurisdiction of the Government of Iran; \n(i) the terms ‘‘knowledge’’ and ‘‘knowingly,’’ with respect to conduct, \na circumstance, or a result, mean that a person has actual knowledge, or \nshould have known, of the conduct, the circumstance, or the result; \n(j) the terms ‘‘Naftiran Intertrade Company’’ and ‘‘NICO’’ mean the Naftiran \nIntertrade Company Ltd. and any entity owned or controlled by, or operating \nfor or on behalf of, the Naftiran Intertrade Company Ltd.; \n(k) the terms ‘‘National Iranian Oil Company’’ and ‘‘NIOC’’ mean the \nNational Iranian Oil Company and any entity owned or controlled by, or \noperating for or on behalf of, the National Iranian Oil Company; \n(l) the term ‘‘person’’ means an individual or entity; \nVerDate Sep<11>2014 17:48 Aug 06, 2018 Jkt 244001 PO 00000 Frm 00011 Fmt 4705 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\07AUE0.SGM 07AUE0daltland on DSKBBV9HB2PROD with PRES DOCS\n=== PDF page 10 of 11 ===\n38948 Federal Register / Vol. 83, No. 152 / Tuesday, August 7, 2018 / Presidential Documents \n(m) the term ‘‘petrochemical products’’ includes any aromatic, olefin, and \nsynthesis gas, and any of their derivatives, including ethylene, propylene, \nbutadiene, benzene, toluene, xylene, ammonia, methanol, and urea; \n(n) the term ‘‘petroleum’’ (also known as crude oil) means a mixture \nof hydrocarbons that exists in liquid phase in natural underground reservoirs \nand remains liquid at atmospheric pressure after passing through surface \nseparating facilities; \n(o) the term ‘‘petroleum products’’ includes unfinished oils, liquefied petro-\nleum gases, pentanes plus, aviation gasoline, motor gasoline, naphtha-type \njet fuel, kerosene-type jet fuel, kerosene, distillate fuel oil, residual fuel \noil, petrochemical feedstocks, special naphthas, lubricants, waxes, petroleum \ncoke, asphalt, road oil, still gas, and miscellaneous products obtained from \nthe processing of: crude oil (including lease condensate), natural gas, and \nother hydrocarbon compounds.","(a) Pursuant to section 202 of the NEA \n(50 U.S.C. 1622), the revocation of Executive Orders 13716 and 13628 as \nset forth in section 9 of this order, shall not affect any action taken or \nproceeding pending not finally concluded or determined as of the effective \ndate of this order, or any action or proceeding based on any act committed \nprior to the effective date of this order, or any rights or duties that matured \nor penalties that were incurred prior to the effective date of this order."],"scope":"partial","signing_date":"2018-08-06","target_id":"EO:13599","verb":"transfer"}

(a)(2)(ii) of this section."},{"char_end":42924,"char_start":42579,"text":"(4) The prohibitions in paragraphs (c)(1) through (c)(3) of this section apply except to the extent transactions are authorized by regulations, orders, directives, or licenses that may be issued pursuant to this part, and notwithstanding any contracts entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the effective date of the prohibition."},{"char_end":49865,"char_start":49575,"text":"(3) A U.S. financial institution shall not maintain a correspondent account or payable-through account in the United States for a foreign financial institution in a manner that is inconsistent with any strict condition imposed and in effect pursuant to paragraph (a)(2)(ii) of this section."},{"char_end":50172,"char_start":49866,"text":"(4) The prohibitions in paragraphs (c)(1) through (c)(3) of this section apply except to the extent provided by regulations, orders, directives, or licenses that may be issued pursuant to this part, and notwithstanding any contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the effective date."},{"char_end":50821,"char_start":50600,"text":"(a) Any transaction on or after the effective date that evades or avoids, has the purpose of evading or avoiding, causes a violation of, or attempts to violate any of the prohibitions set forth in this part is prohibited."},{"char_end":51048,"char_start":50950,"text":"Redesignated at 84 FR 38547, Aug. 7, 2019]\nSubpart C—General Definitions\n§ 561.301 Effective date."},{"char_end":51479,"char_start":51049,"text":"(a) The effective date of a prohibition or condition imposed pursuant to §§ 561.201, 561.203, 561.204, or 561.205 on the opening or maintaining of a correspondent account or a payable-through account in the United States by a U.S. financial institution for a particular foreign financial institution is the earlier of the date the U.S. financial institution receives actual or constructive notice of such prohibition or condition."},{"char_end":51733,"char_start":51480,"text":"(b) The effective date of the prohibition contained in § 561.202 with respect to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps and any of its agents or affiliates whose property and interests in property are blocked as of August 16, 2010, is August 16, 2010."},{"char_end":52086,"char_start":51734,"text":"(c) The effective date of the prohibition contained in § 561.202 with respect to an agent or affiliate of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps whose property and interests in property become blocked after August 16, 2010, is the earlier of the date of actual or constructive notice that such person's property and interests in property are blocked."},{"char_end":84835,"char_start":83686,"text":"(a) During the 10-day period beginning on the effective date of the prohibition in § 561.201(c), § 561.203(c)(2), § 561.204(c)(2), § 561.205(a), or § 561.205(c) on the maintaining of a correspondent account or a payable-through account for a foreign financial institution whose name is added to the List of Foreign Financial Institutions Subject to Correspondent Account or Payable-Through Account Sanctions (CAPTA List), which is maintained on the Office of Foreign Assets Control's website (https://ofac.treasury.gov), U.S. financial institutions that maintain correspondent accounts or payable-through accounts for the foreign financial institution are authorized to:\n(1) Process only those transactions through the account, or permit the foreign financial institution to execute only those transactions through the account, that are for the purpose of, and necessary for, closing the account; and\n(2) Transfer the funds remaining in the correspondent account or the payable-through account to an account of the foreign financial institution located outside of the United States and close the correspondent account or the payable-through account."}],"exceptions_text":["except for any Iranian financial institution whose property and interests in property are blocked solely pursuant wording lead; chronology does not decide legal effect.","provision_text":"(d) Any person or entity identified by the Secretary of the Treasury to be the Government of Iran under 31 CFR part 560.\n§ 561.322 Entity owned or controlled by the Government of Iran.\nThe phrase entity owned or controlled by the Government of Iran means any entity, including a financial institution, in which the Government of Iran owns a 50 percent or greater interest or a controlling interest, and any entity, including a financial institution, which is otherwise controlled by that government.\n§ 561.323 Foreign financial institution owned or controlled by the government of a foreign country.\nThe phrase foreign financial institution owned or controlled by the government of a foreign country means any foreign financial institution, including a central bank of a foreign country, in which a government of a foreign country owns a 50 percent or greater interest and any foreign financial institution which is otherwise controlled by a government of a foreign country.\n§ 561.324 Designated Iranian financial institution.\nThe term designated Iranian financial institution means any Iranian financial institution whose property and interests in property are blocked by the Department of the Treasury pursuant to any part of this chapter or any Executive order issued pursuant to the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (50 U.S.C. 1701 et seq.) and whose name is listed on the Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List on the Office of Foreign Assets Control's Web site, except for any Iranian financial institution whose property and interests in property are blocked solely pursuant to Executive Order 13599 of February 5, 2012.\nNote to § 561.324:\nFacilitating significant transactions or providing significant financial services for a financial institution whose property and interests in property are blocked pursuant to parts 544 or 594 of this chapter in connection with Iran's proliferation of weapons of mass destruction or delivery systems for weapons of mass destruction or Iran's support for international terrorism has, since the enactment of CISADA on July 1, 2010, constituted an activity that could subject a foreign financial institution to prohibitions or strict conditions on correspondent accounts or payable-through accounts in the United States. See § 561.201.\n§ 561.325 Financial transaction.\nThe term financial transaction means any transfer of value involving a financial institution.\n§ 561.326 Privately owned foreign financial institution.\nThe phrase privately owned foreign financial institution means any foreign financial institution that is not owned or controlled by the government of a foreign country.\n§ 561.327 Agricultural commodities, food, medicine, and medical devices.","sections_touched":["part 560","parts 544"],"signing_date":"2019-06-24","source":{"acceptable_as_original":false,"filing_date":null,"grade":"held_text_lead","instrument_id":"EO:13876","page_or_item":"31 CFR part 561","requires_page_check":false,"sha256":"4dcb0cebcae9238592129e0226f2d5068db5d2aac74cca3b090eb3f1f3c0548b","signing_date":"2019-06-24","text_path":"jobs/theophilus-sources/output/texts/cfr-t31-part561.txt","text_sha256":"4dcb0cebcae9238592129e0226f2d5068db5d2aac74cca3b090eb3f1f3c0548b","url":"https://www.ecfr.gov/on/2026-11-05/title-31/part-561"},"verb":"transfer"}],"generic_refs_excluded":234,"id":"CHAIN:EO:13599","notes":"Named, located change provisions only; missing provisions and unheld texts remain dossier gaps. {"actor_id":"EO:12959","char_end":5917,"char_start":5719,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":1299,"char_start":784,"text":"The following are prohibited, except to the extent provided in regulations, orders, directives, or licenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding any contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior to the effective date of this order: (a) the importation into the United States, or the financing of such importation, of any goods or services of Iranian origin, other than Iranian-origin publications and materials imported for news publications or news broadcast dissemination;"},{"char_end":2394,"char_start":1735,"text":"(c) the reexportation to Iran, the Government of Iran, or to any entity owned or controlled by the Government of Iran, of any goods or technology (including technical data or other information) exported from the United States, the exportation of which to Iran is subject to export license application requirements under any United States regulations in effect immediately prior to the issuance of this order, unless, for goods, they have been (i) substantially transformed outside the United States, or (ii) incorporated into another product outside the United States and constitute less than 10 percent by value of that product exported from a third country;"},{"char_end":7194,"char_start":6498,"text":"(a) This order is effective at 12:01 a.m., eastern daylight time, on May 7, 1995, except that (i) section 1(b), (c), and (d) of this order shall not apply until 12:01 a.m., eastern daylight time, on June 6, 1995, to trade transactions under contracts in force as of the date of this order if such transactions are authorized pursuant to Federal regulations in force immediately prior to the date of this order (\"existing trade contracts\"), and (ii) letters of credit and other financing agreements with respect to existing trade contracts may be performed pursuant to their terms with respect to underlying trade transactions occurring prior to 12:01 a.m., eastern daylight time, on June 6, 1995."}],"exceptions_text":["to the extent inconsistent with this order"],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12957>EO:12959@26faecf288a58a64","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted.
